emplacement: Ouverture, sous le tapuscrit à feuilleter
alt: Table de lecture couverte de tapuscrits
consigne_scene: Top-down view of a long worn oak reading table covered with a loose fan of typed manuscripts whose lines are blank and unreadable, a red pencil and a black binder clip, the left half of the frame left as calm empty ivory paper

emplacement: Image qui s'ouvre en plein écran (lecture publique)
alt: Plateau vide préparé pour une lecture, quatre pupitres éclairés
consigne_scene: An empty small theatre stage in soft darkness with four simple wooden reading desks in a row, each lit by its own small warm reading lamp, an empty chair behind each desk, a few typed pages with blank lines resting on the desks, seen from the first row of empty seats, nobody
lumiere: small warm pools of lamp light in soft darkness

alt: Lecteur de dos annotant un tapuscrit au crayon rouge
consigne_scene: Over-the-shoulder view from behind of one reader at a desk annotating a typed manuscript with a red pencil, head out of frame, only one hand visible, the manuscript lines blank and unreadable, warm desk lamp

alt: Tapuscrit tenu par une pince, sortant d'une enveloppe kraft
consigne_scene: A typed manuscript held by a black binder clip sliding out of a plain kraft envelope on an oak table, the manuscript lines blank and unreadable, the right third of the frame left as calm empty wood

alt: Haute pile de tapuscrits aux tranches éclairées
consigne_scene: A tall neat stack of about twenty-six typed manuscripts of slightly different thicknesses on an oak table, blank covers, the paper edges catching raking light, the upper half of the frame left as a calm warm wall

alt: Petite salle après une lecture publique, pupitres éteints
consigne_scene: An empty small theatre just after a public reading: four reading desks with their lamps switched off, a few empty chairs, a handful of typed pages with blank lines left on the floor, dim warm work light, nobody

alt: Enveloppe kraft et tapuscrit sous une lampe, la nuit
consigne_scene: Night scene: a plain kraft envelope and a typed manuscript held by a black binder clip on a dark wooden desk, lit by a single warm desk lamp, deep ink-black shadows, the left half of the frame dark and empty, the manuscript lines blank and unreadable
lumiere: a single warm desk lamp in deep darkness

alt: Trois piles de fiches de lecture à côté d'un tapuscrit
consigne_scene: Top-down view of three separate small stacks of blank index cards next to one typed manuscript with blank lines, a red pencil and a blue ballpoint pen, a few abstract red pencil strokes on the cards, oak table

alt: Quatre lampes de lecture sur une longue table, chacune sur sa pile de textes
consigne_scene: Four reading lamps on a long dark wooden table at dusk, their necks bending in four different directions like four heads, each casting a warm pool of light on its own pile of typed manuscripts with blank lines, seen from the end of the table, the upper half of the frame dark and calm
lumiere: four warm pools of lamp light in blue dusk

alt: Marais calme dans la brume du matin
consigne_scene: A calm misty marsh at dawn, tall reeds and still dark water, soft blue and ivory light, very quiet, no buildings, nobody

alt: Bureau près d'une fenêtre, pile d'enveloppes kraft
consigne_scene: A wooden desk by a tall window with a neat pile of plain kraft envelopes without any writing, a fountain pen and a red pencil, soft daylight, panoramic composition with calm empty space on both sides
lieu: a quiet office of a theatre

alt: Une servante allumée sur un plateau vide
consigne_scene: A theatre ghost light, a single bare bulb on a simple metal stand, left alone in the middle of an empty dark stage, one blank sheet of paper on the floor beside it, faint haze, nobody, the upper half of the frame dark
lumiere: the bare light of a single bulb in darkness
